# Evan Borden — Engineering Manager & Adobe Architect

> Evan Borden is an engineering manager and Adobe solutions architect based in Charlotte, North Carolina. At Razorfish, a martech agency, he manages engineering staffing, hiring and resource planning, and serves as technical lead and architect across flagship client accounts — Disney Rewards, UC Health and Labcorp. He was Tech Lead on Disney Rewards from 2022 until the GVP of Technology and CTO at the time entrusted him with leading Labcorp, which he still leads. He delivered both of his 2026 Labcorp projects into production, which led to retainer work through the end of 2026, with the potential for more in 2027.

Site: https://www.evanborden.com/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/evan-borden/
Email: evanpatrickborden@outlook.com
Location: Charlotte, NC, United States
Currently: Manager of Engineering at Razorfish (November 2018 – present)
Open to: Engineering Manager, Director of Engineering, Technical Director, Solutions Architect

## Summary

Evan Borden leads front-end, back-end and QA engineering teams across multi-year enterprise client engagements. His background runs from enterprise WordPress and Adobe Experience Manager platforms to the wider Adobe cloud stack — App Builder, Experience Platform and Journey Optimizer — and modern CI/CD on GitLab and Azure DevOps. He interviews and hires development and QA engineers across experience levels, works with staffing leads to source talent in India and Costa Rica, plans resource dates, rates and margin with project managers, takes architecture through client architecture review boards, and reviews every data path for security and PHI exposure under HIPAA. He partners daily with VP-and-above technical leaders, and was entrusted with leading the Labcorp account by the GVP of Technology and CTO at the time.

## Current work: Labcorp (2026)

Evan delivered both of his 2026 Labcorp projects into production: **Marker by Labcorp** and **Thrive 5 Personalization**. On both he served as **Adobe Architect and Tech Lead**. That success turned into retainer work through the end of 2026, with the potential for more in 2027.

### Marker by Labcorp

Adobe Architect and Tech Lead on a media-driven landing page for a custom Labcorp product, delivered on a tight timeline. Evan led the technical implementation and the team building custom AEM as a Cloud Service components across the back end and front end. He stayed on camera with the client at every step, ran ticket management, and worked hand in hand with the project manager to get it live.

### Thrive 5 Personalization

Evan owned the solution architecture for a personalization program spanning AEM as a Cloud Service, Adobe App Builder, Adobe Experience Platform and Adobe Journey Optimizer, feeding a downstream proprietary Patient Portal that must stay HIPAA-compliant. His team built the App Builder and AEP/AJO layers; AEM and the Patient Portal were delivered by partner teams, and the work required close coordination across those teams and with the client.

- **Solution architecture** — end-to-end design across AEMaaCS, App Builder, AEP/AJO and the Patient Portal, taken through the client's architecture review board, with every data path reviewed for PHI exposure under HIPAA.
- **Adobe App Builder** (built by his team) — the integration tier: custom services and React UI extensions connecting AEM, AEP/AJO and the Patient Portal.
- **Adobe I/O** (built by his team) — serverless actions on I/O Runtime, event-driven integration through I/O Events, and project, workspace and credential setup via the aio CLI and Developer Console.
- **Adobe Experience Platform (AEP)** (built by his team) — the unified customer profile: datasets and data ingestion, identity stitching, and segment definitions feeding downstream activation.
- **Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO)** (built by his team) — journey, campaign and channel configuration on AEP profiles: event triggers, audience entry, channel surfaces, and message templates.
- **Decision Management / Offer Decisioning** — offer catalog, decision rules and selection strategies governing what each profile is served.
- **XDM schema modeling** — XDM class and schema design, field groups and identity maps underpinning the profile.
- **AEM as a Cloud Service** — architected its role in the solution and its integration points; built by a partner team.

## Experience

### Manager of Engineering — Razorfish (Nov 2018 – present)
- Runs staffing and interviewing for development and QA roles across experience levels and role types.
- Works directly with staffing leads to source technical talent in Costa Rica and India, and fills project roles from both internal and external candidates.
- Works with project managers on resource start and end dates, role rates and cost, and staffing adjustments to protect margin.
- Tech Lead and primary Adobe Experience Manager developer on UC Health (AEM 6.5 on-premise) from 2018 to 2023, while developing on Disney Rewards at the same time.
- Tech Lead on Disney Rewards from 2022, overlapping with UC Health, until the GVP of Technology and CTO at the time entrusted him with leading Labcorp, which he still leads.
- Delivered both of his 2026 Labcorp projects, Marker by Labcorp and Thrive 5 Personalization, into production as Adobe Architect and Tech Lead; this led to retainer work through the end of 2026, with the potential for more in 2027.
- On Thrive 5 Personalization, owned the solution architecture across AEM, App Builder, AEP/AJO and a downstream HIPAA-compliant Patient Portal; his team built the App Builder and AEP/AJO layers, and he coordinated partner teams and client stakeholders.
- Takes architecture recommendations through client architecture review boards within the wider enterprise infrastructure.
- Identifies every data path in an architecture for security concerns and PHI handling under HIPAA.
- Contributes directly to statements of work, reviews RFPs, and vets technical requirements and levels of effort with delivery teams.
- Builds slide decks, demos technical functionality to live audiences, and writes architecture research and discovery documentation.
- Uses Claude, ChatGPT and other models day to day to draft architecture documents, write Confluence documentation against real codebases, automate Jira ticket resolution, and build his own tools that generate Word, Excel and PowerPoint deliverables.

### Senior Web Developer — Interactive Knowledge (Sep 2012 – Oct 2018)
- Built media-rich interactive experiences for non-profits, museums and educational institutions.
- Shipped responsive, mobile-first applications in React and Vue against custom REST and microservice backends.

### Earlier roles (2008 – 2012)
- Evan has worked professionally since 2008, but it started long before that: DOS commands on Windows PCs as a child, the Linux command line in high school, building PCs and teaching himself to build websites from online tutorials. Technology has been a lifelong fascination, and he always knew he wanted to build his career around it.

## Selected projects

- **Thrive 5 Personalization** (Razorfish for Labcorp, 2026) — Adobe Architect and Tech Lead; solution architecture across AEMaaCS, App Builder, AEP/AJO and a HIPAA-compliant Patient Portal, with his team building App Builder and AEP/AJO. In production.
- **Marker by Labcorp** (Razorfish for Labcorp, 2026) — Adobe Architect and Tech Lead; led the technical implementation and the team building custom AEM as a Cloud Service components, back end and front end, for a media-driven landing page for a custom Labcorp product, delivered on a tight timeline. Worked on camera with the client throughout, ran ticket management and partnered closely with the project manager. In production.
- **Disney Rewards** (Razorfish, developer from 2019, Tech Lead 2022–2026, until moving to Labcorp) — custom WordPress platform, bespoke Gutenberg blocks, ACF Pro field architecture, Chase Bank API integration via JWT/JOSE, Adobe CJA, Adobe Target. Shipped through GitLab CI/CD.
- **UC Health** (Razorfish, Tech Lead 2018–2023) — Tech Lead and primary AEM developer on AEM 6.5 on-premise; multi-module AEM project on Maven: OSGi services, Sling models and servlets, HTL templating, JCR packaging, Vue 2 clientlibs, Epic EHR integration architecture.

## Leadership scope

- Leads front-end, back-end and QA engineers.

- AI-augmented delivery: Claude, ChatGPT and other models for architecture documents, Confluence documentation, Jira ticket automation and Office deliverables.
- Technical lead on flagship accounts, often more than one at once: UC Health (2018–2023), Disney Rewards (2022–2026), Labcorp (2026–present).
- Hiring reach: US, India, Costa Rica — including hiring his own successor on Disney Rewards.
- Partners with VP-and-above technical leaders; entrusted with leading Labcorp by the GVP of Technology and CTO at the time.
- Sets coding conventions, naming, formatting and review standards across teams.
